scope: Checked CPU int64 scalars, int alias/default integer inference, private native interfaces, exact CLI values and mixed-width worker captures/results.

semantics.types: Signed 64-bit scalars and int alias; unconstrained whole-number literals infer int64. Contextual literals retain int32/uint32/float32 typing. Typed values never silently change family/width.
semantics.literals: INT64_MIN parsed with sign without overflowing a signed magnitude. Fractional/exponent integer initializers and out-of-range values diagnosed. Constant binding/arithmetic checks use signed 128-bit intermediates to avoid compiler UB.
semantics.arithmetic: Add/subtract/multiply/negate sign-extend to i128, check signed int64 bounds and narrow. Existing int32 uses i64 intermediates; unsigned32 unchanged.
semantics.division: Guarded native i64 signed division, zero and INT64_MIN/-1 division faults. Remainder replaces the divisor with one for the exceptional minimum/-1 pair, returning zero without LLVM poison. No widened software division.
semantics.entry: Dedicated signed64 C-interface/CLI entry and exact decimal formatting. Existing float32/int32/uint32 entry ABI unchanged.
semantics.tasks: Distinct scalar.int64 layout keys/IDs with 8-byte storage/alignment. Common continuation planner emits Int64Literal and checked scalar kernels; mixed int64/int32/uint32/float32 packets and all four root types preserve exact values.
semantics.failure: Child arithmetic faults retain source locations and become TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic. Recovery can reuse owned parent tensors. Root/coordinating faults and admission/allocation rejection settle existing scheduling/ownership rules.
semantics.remaining: Int64 tensor arithmetic/reductions/matmul, uint64, float64, conversions and GPU int64 remain gated. No public foreign-memory/wire ABI or distributed execution.

coverage: both signed endpoints and integer values beyond float64 precision
21 by 21 boundary pairs and 10000 deterministic full-range pairs per operator
independent signed128 reference for six operators
overflow for add/subtract/multiply/negation and minimum/-1 division
signed truncating division and mathematical minimum/-1 remainder zero
failed scalar result zero and source location
compile-time constant/binding overflow without host UB
int alias and default integer/function-return inference
strict mixed type/width rejection and scalar-only capability gates
private native forwarding interfaces and exact CLI endpoints
static arithmetic errors preserve executable/LLVM output
nested workers, cached/aliased handles and mixed float tensor captures
owned sibling cancellation/settlement and Arithmetic recovery
all four scalar families share captures and each becomes the root output
root allocation/admission rejection and zero-live-allocation cleanup
shared signed32 arithmetic/task tests and frontend semantics updated for accepted default inference

performance: Correctness and width-aware implementation milestone; no measured arithmetic/task speedup claim.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
